crossExchangeObservations.summary: Goodluck India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 12, 2026, titled "a press release regarding Goodluck Defence and Aerospace Limited, subsidiary of the Company, approved as the Sole Eligible & Technically Qualified Bidder for Specialized 155 mm HE M1A4 Ready-to-Fill Artillery Shells to Munitions India Limited .".

Outcome of Board Meeting
crossExchangeObservations.summary: Goodluck India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on October 12, 2026.We wish to inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company in its meeting, held today i.e. 12th October, 2026 which concluded at 12:45 P.M. (IST), has, inter alia, considered the proposal and accorded its in-principle approval for enlargement of the scope of the aforesaid corporate restructuring to include proposed amalgamation of Goodluck Defence and Aerospace Limited, a material subsidiary of the Company along with Goodluck Green Energy Limited with and into the Company.
